initialization: fresh clean state, 700 real ECBC steps under each corresponding model; first four states per domain unforced, last four terminal excitation
data_role: TEST only; excluded from optimizer and model selection
admission: all finite noncontact states with roll<=.35, rollrate<=1.5 and steer<=.6; preserve all rejected states, no replacement
stop_rule: exactly 22400 lower ticks, zero optimizer; preserve all failures, no replacement
